prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Listen to sound preview"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Choose how you want your new pet to interact with your workspace daily.", "Explore Paths"]
2: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Interact with our mascot while we set up your desktop companion."]
3: ["Getting Started with Your Pet", "Here are the quick actions to manage your pet on your desktop."]
4: ["Signing into your registered account automatically restores your saved pets and progress."]
5: ["Feel free to minimize the app. We will alert you as soon as your pet is ready!"]
6: ["Upload a Clear Front-Facing Photo", "For best results, use a well-lit photo looking straight at the camera with a clear background.", "Avoid dark shadows or side angles for accurate pet generation."]
7: ["Unique Personality"]
8: ["Welcome Your New Companion!", "Your adoption certificate is ready. Give your pet a name and make it official!", "Finalize Adoption"]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Enjoy your new companion! Click and drag your pet anytime or right-click to access controls.", "Start Playing"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requesting a user photo
